data.narrative:
Parallel Systems is a Series B transportation company founded by Matt Soule, John Howard, and Ben Stabler that has raised $100M to date. The valuation universe consists of eight private transportation peers including Rivian, The Boring Company, Einride, Arc Boats, and The ePlane Company; no public transportation comparables were identified.

The Stage-Progression method was the applicable triangulation approach. Using total capital raised ($100M) and deriving a $25M proxy base value, this method applies a 1.9x step-up multiplier typical of Series B advancement to subsequent stages, yielding an implied valuation of $48M. The Peer-Median method was not applicable due to insufficient narrow peer coverage—while three same-sector peers exist in Transportation, none met the filters for same-stage, adjacent-stage, or similar-valuation-tier clustering required to generate a reliable median.

The analysis supports a valuation range of $40M to $55M, with a median point of $48M. However, this range reflects a single triangulation method and thus carries material uncertainty. The key limitation is the sparse comparable set; a more robust valuation would require either identifying additional same-stage Transportation peers or expanding the applicability of peer-median analysis through broader inclusion criteria. Investors should treat this range as preliminary pending deeper market data or additional transaction reference points.
